speaker: Sheldon
text: Come on, we should go. Hang on. Straightening up.

speaker: Leonard
text: What are you doing? Shelton, this is not your home.

speaker: Sheldon
text: This is not anyone's home. This is a swirling vortex of entropy.

speaker: Leonard
text: When the transvestite lived here, you didn't care how he kept the place.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Because it was immaculate. I mean, you opened that man's closet, it was left to right, evening gowns, cocktail dresses, and his police uniforms. What were you doing in his closet? I helped him run some cable for a webcam.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, hey, Penny. This just arrived. We just brought this up. Just now.

speaker: Penny
text: Hey, guys. Great. But was it hard getting up the stairs?

speaker: Leonard
text: No. Ow. We'll get out of here.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Penny, I just want you to know that you don't have to live like this. I'm here for you.

speaker: Leonard
text: It's a joke. Yeah, he didn't tell it right.
